name: GC Time (% of wall-clock)
description: 2-minute timeshift delta of jvm_gc_collection_seconds_sum, as % of wall-clock time.
programText:
raw = data('jvm_gc_collection_seconds_sum', filter=filter('namespace', 'confluent') and filter('service.name', 'controlcenter') and filter('service.instance.id', 'controlcenter-0'))
(((raw - raw.timeshift('2m')) / 120) * 100).publish(label='GC Time %')
